source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: AppDelegate starts StatusBarController, which chooses via MenuBarEngineFactory a native or legacy engine to hide the menu bar icons. The reveal and palette features and the icon catalog rely on this controller.
